name: Hearty mushroom, black bean and walnut plate
description: A very large soy-free vegan lunch or dinner plate for a high calorie target: eighteen and a half cups of sliced mushrooms seared hard in dry pans, warmed through with drained black beans and cooked lentils, then finished with chopped walnuts and sunflower seeds.
instructions: Set two wide non-stick pans over high heat, divide the mushrooms between them in a single layer and leave them undisturbed for 4 minutes so they brown rather than steam.
Stir once, add the salt and the black pepper, and cook for 4 minutes more until both pans are dry again.
Divide the black beans and the lentils between the pans and warm them through for 2 minutes, pressing them lightly into the surface.
Pile everything onto one large plate and scatter the walnuts and the sunflower seeds over the top.
